runtime/uuid#

The native layer under uuid/generation: the calls that module makes into the host runtime.

Version: v1.0.0

Description#

The native layer under uuid/generation: the calls that module makes into the host runtime. Programs use that module instead; these declarations may change with the runtime.

Public API#

native uuid_named#

native uuid_named(namespace is @byte, name is @byte, version is int) is @byte

A name-based UUID (version 3 or 5) of name in namespace.
